---
title: "Introduction to Bayesian Regression modelling with brms"
---

- Date: 7 May 2025 
- Presenter: Michael Jones
- Time: 1230 - 1330
- Location: The Shed at the Digital Greenhouse

[Sign up at Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/introduction-to-bayesian-regression-with-brms-tickets-1333186840729?aff=oddtdtcreator)

Bayesian statistics provides an alternative way to view statistical modelling compared with frequentist statistics. Bayesian methods often better enable us to answer the questions we really want to ask. 

In the past it has been hard to carry out work in the Bayesian paradigm but brms brings the power of the stan probabilistic programming language to R using R's familiar and powerful modelling syntax.

Join us for an introductory session showcasing brms and Bayesian methods.

Slides for the presentation will be made available after the event.
